items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Something about Fred Dodd. Yeah, with Banner.' Interviewee does not respond to the mention of Fred Dodd, only to 'Uncle Buck'.

ctx.x: Everybody thought that was Irving's name. I gave Irving that name, Pasola. You know, when he was learning, when he was learning, you know, I told him, I said, now you go play with the tagging band, the De'Go band, twice a week, every voice. Go play with them, give band experience, I told him. Go play with the Pasola band. That's that thing, a little, a little, a little, a little, uh, him and, uh, what is what De'Go's name? Lucas Kiro? Yeah. They would go and play with him, you know, and everything. And Pete…
He died? Oh yeah. But Lucas Kiro? Yeah, he comes around. He's the one who used to play down at that, uh... American Legion. Yeah, Buck Banner. Something about Fred Dodd. Yeah, with Banner.
Uncle Buck, you know. Yeah. Buck Banner was my uncle. Is Buck still around?
